items.title: Every object of the big pro-etale site is covered by spectra of w-contractible rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every object of a big pro-etale site admits a covering by affine objects which are spectra of w-contractible rings, hence weakly contractible (statement lines 3086-3094). The proof (proof lines 3096-3127) covers an affine open piece, replaces it by a faithfully flat ind-etale extension with w-contractible ring, verifies through explicit cardinality estimates that the resulting affine schemes are objects of the big site, and concludes by the equivalence between w-contractibility and weak contractibility. H2: a construction with a genuine size estimate and three inputs, written out in full.
